objective: Run the one authorized frozen offline audit of dead-parent write elision and single-use immediate forwarding on M504's exact 1RW parent scratch, without changing arithmetic, issue order, output commit, checkpoint, or accuracy.

frozen_coordinate.population: 10 samples x 4 bottleneck Conv3x3 x 432 partitions x 3000 rows
frozen_coordinate.scratch: nine generated 128x128b 1RW macros, lower 64 rows used
frozen_coordinate.arithmetic: Exact M473 signed12 parent/residual reconstruction and signed19 resident psum.

mode_definitions.m504_baseline: Every active row writes parent scratch; existing same-cycle forwarding serves one ordered edge but does not elide the store.
mode_definitions.dead_write_only: A row with exact parent refcount zero suppresses only its parent-scratch write; arithmetic issue and architectural output commit remain unchanged.
mode_definitions.combined_pvrf: Dead writes are suppressed; when exact refcount is one and the sole next ordered edge is legally forwarded at producer completion, its store is also suppressed. Multi-use parents always write.
mode_definitions.metadata: Two-bit saturating 0/1/2+ reference class for each of 64 rows, 128 bits per task, generated after exact matching. It is not a free oracle and must enter matched RTL/DC if nominated.
mode_definitions.port_rule: At most one macro read XOR one macro write per cycle; internal forwarding serves at most one ordered parent edge and does not add a second lookahead descriptor.
mode_definitions.response_rule: One-cycle synchronous read response, queue plus pending capacity two, no same-cycle consume credit, no read before producer store.

materiality_gates.rtl_rule: All five gates and an independent result hammer must pass before RTL may be discussed.

fail_closed: Abort on any frozen SHA, M473 anchor, M504 anchor, task order, population, arithmetic issue, active row, parent edge, output commit, or macro-access anchor drift.
Abort on a dropped, duplicated, or reordered parent edge, read before producer store, simultaneous macro read/write, queue overflow, or unbounded progress.
Dead means exact refcount zero. A live single-use store may be elided only when its sole ordered edge is forwarded at producer completion. Multi-use parents always write.
Report M504, dead-only, and combined modes separately; never cite the combined point without both ablations.
If the full-pipeline cycle gate fails, close the line even if macro accesses fall materially.
Never call this offline audit RTL, Synopsys, system speedup, integrated PPA, or DATE headline evidence.
